T13.title: Digit 行走时同时跟踪双手目标
T13.upstream_runtime: IsaacLab 2.3.2 pinned; supports Isaac Sim 4.5/5.0/5.1 upstream
T13.observation: Original noisy policy state: base velocity/gravity, velocity and hand pose commands, joint positions/velocities, previous action. Not RGB-only.
T13.action: Original full body leg+arm joint position action, scale 0.5 plus default offsets, no pretrained walking controller.
T13.scoring: Native reward components, native command tracking errors and termination; no invented binary success metric. No carried box/object.
